digest.component_or_area: completion verifier agentic context assembly and prefetching
propositions: The completion verifier discovers files agentic-ally via 84-158 round-trip tool calls per run, dominated by repeated search_files queries for files the tickets already declare in file_impact, causing wall-clock cost and budget overruns in runaway loops

Pre-fetching the ticket's declared file_impact contents and referencing-commit diffs into the assembled ticket_context eliminates opening discovery requests and reduces verifier request count by at least 20% while maintaining verdict equivalence
The close gate (graph=False) must prefetch only the closing ticket's own file_impact, never the subtree union, to honour the completion-criteria boundary that prevents the original runaway bug

Prefetched file bodies marked 'skeleton' (skeleton-compressed files over 500 lines) must be re-read in full via read_file tool; full bodies are trusted directly as representing the verification ref's working tree

The prefetch section is appended to the byte-stable fenced ticket_context before the <!--volatile--> marker so it cache-reads across batched recovery successor runs via the existing automatic prompt cache
The assemble_context function gains an opt-in prefetch parameter (default None) so shared review-ticket callers remain byte-identical and only the completion gate passes a PrefetchSpec
